status: Research/design only. No plugin import, compile, server setup, pairing, or physical-device test performed.
confirmed_request: Automatic family discovery and joining while app is foregrounded; either iPad can host or join.
recommendation: Native declared Bonjour discovery, stable single authority per connected session, PC preference at session start, either iPad as LAN host, custom checkpoint recovery and branch reconciliation.
important_findings: Apple TN3213 says Xcode 27 deprecates MPC; use older Network framework APIs for iPadOS 18, not its iOS 26-only sample syntax.
NWBrowser availability begins iPadOS 13; NWListener begins iPadOS 12.
Apple DTS says MPC no longer supports Bluetooth networking despite older overview text.
Declared Bonjour browsing differs from raw UDP broadcast/multicast entitlement requirements.
Background/suspended iPads cannot be relied on as always-running hosts.
Unity host election does not migrate state; current default migration is Netcode for Entities, with NGO documentation pointing to Distributed Authority.
An offline partition requires separate branches; automatically reconnecting is not equivalent to safely merging divergent saves.

repositories.finding: Selected discovery source uses UdpClient, IPAddress.Broadcast, EnableBroadcast; avoid as default iPad discovery dependency.
Unity 2021.3 metadata; MPC wrappers. Browser wrapper ignores supplied context/timeout and uses nil context, timeout 7. Reference only.
